renewable.heroSubtitle: IEC-compliant thermal and visual inspections for solar farms and wind turbines across Europe. Identify revenue-draining faults, soiling, and degradation — delivered in 48 hours, at a fraction of ground-based cost.
renewable.solarDesc: Our IEC 62446-3 compliant thermal imaging inspections identify hotspots, degraded strings, soiling, and panel misalignment across utility-scale solar installations. AI-powered fault classification prioritises findings by revenue impact — not just temperature delta.
renewable.solarF0: IEC 62446-3 compliant data capture and reporting
renewable.solarF1: Simultaneous thermal IR and RGB at prescribed GSD
renewable.solarF2: AI classification: hotspots, PID, soiling, bypass diode faults
renewable.solarF3: Geo-referenced defect maps for maintenance crews
renewable.solarF4: Up to 50 MW inspected per day
renewable.windDesc: Advanced drone technology for comprehensive wind turbine inspections, detecting blade surface defects, leading edge erosion, lightning strike damage, and structural anomalies. Delivered in collaboration with Sulzer Schmid Laboratories AG using 3DX photogrammetric reconstruction.
renewable.windF1: Leading edge erosion and crack detection
renewable.windF3: 3DX technology in collaboration with Sulzer Schmid
renewable.thermalDesc: Drag the divider to compare a standard RGB drone image against thermal imaging — revealing hotspots and degraded cells invisible to the naked eye.
renewable.thermalNote: Thermal anomalies indicate degraded cells, soiling, and connection faults — identified remotely at scale across hundreds of MW per day.
renewable.p0Desc: We review panel layout, capacity, and any historical fault data before mobilisation to define flight paths and GSD requirements.
renewable.p1Desc: Simultaneous thermal IR and RGB flight at IEC 62446-3 prescribed GSDs. Data validated for completeness on-site before crew departure.
renewable.p2Desc: Automated anomaly detection pipeline classifies hotspots, degraded strings, soiling, and module-level faults by type and severity.
renewable.p3Desc: Structured defect report with geo-referenced fault locations, severity scores, and maintenance prioritisation — delivered within 48 hours.
renewable.t0Desc: Every solar inspection follows the international standard for thermographic testing of PV installations.
renewable.t1Desc: Machine learning pipeline categorises anomalies by type and estimated revenue impact — not just temperature delta.
renewable.t2Desc: Structured, geo-referenced defect reports ready for maintenance scheduling within 48 hours of data capture.
renewable.ctaSub: Discover how drone inspections can optimise your renewable energy assets.

infra.heroSubtitle: Drone inspections for powerlines, gas pipelines, telecom towers, and rail corridors. Replace rope access and manual patrols with rapid aerial coverage — delivering GPS-tagged defect reports without shutting down the asset.
infra.telecomDesc: Full visual and condition inspection of telecom towers without the cost, risk, or scheduling delays of rope access crews. GPS-tagged defect reports ready for your asset management system.
infra.tc0Desc: High-resolution close-visual and thermal imaging for early identification of structural deterioration, corrosion, antenna misalignment, and mounting hardware defects.
infra.tc1Desc: Accurate terrain and obstruction data for optimal new tower placement analysis and radio frequency planning.
infra.tc2Desc: 3D terrain modelling and coverage simulation for efficient network expansion, densification, and optimisation decisions.
infra.tc3Desc: Rapid aerial assessment after storm damage, flooding, or other incidents — supporting fast restoration without endangering personnel.
infra.powerDesc: Aerial inspection of transmission and distribution networks at scale — detecting conductor damage, thermal hotspots, and vegetation encroachment across hundreds of kilometres per engagement.
infra.pl0Desc: Comprehensive detection of conductor damage, insulator degradation, and vegetation encroachment along transmission and distribution corridors.
infra.pl1Desc: Thermal hotspot detection on connections, fittings, and insulators — identifying equipment failure risks before they cause outages.
infra.pl2Desc: 3D corridor modelling for statutory clearance analysis, vegetation management planning, and sag/blow-out calculations.
infra.pl3Desc: Automated encroachment detection and clearance zone monitoring to support vegetation management contractors and network operators.
infra.w0Desc: EASA Specific Category licensed crew. No personnel required in hazardous zones, at height, or in confined spaces.
infra.w1Desc: Cover 40 km of linear assets per day versus a fraction of that with traditional ground or rope-access crews.
infra.w2Desc: Every defect location is precisely geo-referenced, exportable to GIS and asset management platforms.
infra.w3Desc: Eliminate scaffolding, rope access, and road closure costs while capturing higher-quality visual data.
infra.ctaTitle: Get in Touch to Learn More
infra.ctaSub: Discover how drone inspections can transform your infrastructure operations.

oilgas.heroSubtitle: Aerial inspections for pipelines, refineries, and offshore platforms. Cover 40 km per day, eliminate hazardous manual access, and receive structured defect reports — without disrupting operations.
oilgas.stat0Sub: vs. under 5 km with ground crews
oilgas.s0Desc: Aerial inspections via rapid data capture and off-site specialist evaluation dramatically reduce operational downtime. Full structured reports with high-resolution imagery allow engineering decisions to be made without extended field visits or asset shutdowns.
oilgas.s0F0: Rapid aerial data capture in minutes per km
oilgas.s0F4: DAM-compatible data formats for easy integration
oilgas.s1Desc: Aerata drones safely inspect offshore rigs, refineries, tank farms, and pipeline networks — removing the need for personnel to work at height, in confined spaces, or in hazardous atmospheric environments. Our platforms are weather-rated for continuous field operations.
oilgas.s1F0: No personnel required in hazardous zones
oilgas.s1F1: Offshore rig and platform structural inspections
oilgas.s1F2: Pipeline corridor monitoring — 40 km per day
oilgas.s1F4: IP45-rated platforms for adverse weather operations
oilgas.p0Desc: We work with your HSE and operations teams to plan flight corridors, identify no-fly zones, and secure required operational permits.
oilgas.p1Desc: Multi-sensor data capture including high-resolution RGB, thermal IR, and LiDAR along the asset corridor — in a single mobilisation.
oilgas.p2Desc: Specialist data review identifies corrosion, cracks, leaks, coating failures, third-party encroachments, and vegetation threats.
oilgas.p3Desc: Structured defect reports with GPS-tagged locations, imagery, severity scores, and recommended actions — delivered within 48 hours.
oilgas.t0Desc: Drone inspections eliminate the need to put personnel in hazardous environments, reducing RIDDOR incident risk to near zero on inspection activities.
oilgas.t1Desc: Inspections run without shutting down the asset. Pipelines, tanks, and platforms are assessed live — no production downtime required.
oilgas.t2Desc: Every finding is geo-referenced and exportable to your asset management and GIS systems. Full photo evidence library included.
oilgas.t3Desc: DJI Matrice 300/350 RTK with thermal, zoom, and LiDAR payloads. IP45-rated for operation in rain, wind, and cold environments.
oilgas.ctaSub: Learn how drone operations can reduce costs and improve safety across your oil & gas assets.

environment.heroSubtitle: High-resolution aerial surveys for habitat mapping, biodiversity assessment, water quality monitoring, and precision agriculture. Multispectral and thermal data collected at scale — delivered in compliance-ready GIS formats.
environment.s0Desc: Drone-based environmental monitoring delivers accurate habitat mapping, pollution detection, and comprehensive ecosystem assessments. Multi-spectral and thermal sensors provide the data resolution needed for informed conservation and regulatory compliance decisions.
environment.s0F1: Water quality and pollution gradient detection
environment.s0F2: Coastal erosion and intertidal zone monitoring
environment.s1Desc: AI-driven analytics for species identification, population estimation, and change detection across protected areas and development site footprints. Drone surveys produce detailed maps and reports that support conservation planning and statutory ecological assessments.
environment.s1F0: AI-assisted species identification from aerial imagery
environment.s1F1: Population density estimation across survey areas
environment.s1F3: Detailed biodiversity reports and GIS maps
environment.s2Desc: Optimise crop health, irrigation efficiency, and nutrient management with AI-powered drone analytics. NDVI, NDRE, and thermal mapping identify problem zones before they affect yield — enabling targeted intervention rather than blanket treatment.
environment.s2F0: NDVI and NDRE crop health analysis
environment.s2F1: Irrigation efficiency and water stress mapping
environment.s2F2: Nutrient deficiency and disease risk detection
environment.s2F3: Prescription maps for field machinery integration
environment.cap0Desc: Multispectral mapping of water bodies for chlorophyll-a, turbidity, and NDWI indices. Tracks seasonal change and identifies pollution gradients across reservoirs and catchments.
environment.cap1Desc: Multi-spectral NDVI and classification mapping for habitat assessment, invasive species detection, and biodiversity baseline surveys in support of conservation and regulatory compliance.
environment.cap2Desc: High-resolution orthomosaics and DSMs for coastal erosion monitoring, intertidal zone mapping, and protected habitat assessments.
environment.cap3Desc: NDVI, NDRE, and thermal crop health mapping for targeted irrigation, fertiliser, and intervention planning — delivered as prescription maps for field machinery.
environment.p0Desc: Sensor selection, flight altitude, GSD, and temporal frequency defined to match the environmental variable being monitored.
environment.p1Desc: Simultaneous RGB, thermal, and/or multispectral data capture at prescribed altitudes. Radiometric calibration panels captured at flight start and end.
environment.p2Desc: Radiometrically corrected reflectance maps, index calculation (NDVI, NDWI, NDRE), and classification layers generated from raw data.
environment.p3Desc: GeoTIFF rasters, shapefiles, and interpretation reports delivered in your required coordinate reference system for direct GIS import.
environment.ctaSub: Contact us for a consultation on environmental monitoring or precision agriculture solutions.

surveying.heroSubtitle: Engineering-grade aerial data for construction, land development, and infrastructure planning. Centimetre-accurate deliverables in GIS, CAD, and BIM-ready formats — captured faster and more safely than ground-based survey crews.
surveying.s0Desc: Using RTK photogrammetry and UAV image stitching, we produce geometrically corrected orthomosaics and detailed 3D models. Our orthophotos provide true-to-scale aerial imagery directly usable in GIS and CAD software, with GCP-controlled accuracy to sub-centimetre.
surveying.s0F1: High-resolution 3D point clouds and mesh models
surveying.s0F2: GIS and CAD compatible outputs (DXF, SHP, GeoTIFF)
surveying.s1Desc: Our LiDAR-equipped drones generate precise Digital Elevation Models and Digital Terrain Models for urban planning, flood modelling, and environmental monitoring. LiDAR penetrates dense vegetation to produce bare-earth models unavailable from photogrammetry alone.
surveying.s1F3: Flood risk assessment and water stream modelling
surveying.s2Desc: Regular aerial surveys with automated progress comparison, volumetric calculations, and as-built versus design analysis. Our drone surveys provide project stakeholders with real-time aerial overviews at every construction phase — from groundworks to final handover.
surveying.s2F0: Automated weekly or fortnightly progress reports
surveying.s2F1: Volume calculations for earthworks and stockpiles
surveying.s3Desc: Aerial data combined with machine learning for anomaly detection, structural change monitoring, and predictive maintenance triggers. Ideal for infrastructure assets that require regular condition assessment over extended timeframes.
surveying.s3F2: Proactive maintenance and early warning alerts
surveying.s3F3: Historical change detection across survey cycles
surveying.capsTitle: What Sets Our Survey Data Apart
surveying.cap0Desc: Real-time kinematic positioning eliminates the need for ground control points on most sites, delivering centimetre-accurate orthomosaics and 3D models faster.
surveying.cap1Desc: Dedicated LiDAR sensors generate dense, classified point clouds that penetrate vegetation canopy — essential for terrain modelling beneath tree cover.
surveying.cap2Desc: Drone surveys cover large areas in hours, not days. A typical 100-hectare site is fully captured in a single flight with sub-centimetre vertical accuracy.
surveying.cap3Desc: All deliverables are formatted for direct import into AutoCAD, Revit, QGIS, ArcGIS, and BIM workflows — no conversion required.
surveying.p0Desc: Flight path optimisation, GSD specification, and ground control point placement based on required accuracy class.
surveying.p1Desc: Simultaneous RGB, LiDAR, and/or multispectral data capture at prescribed overlap. All data validated on-site.
surveying.p2Desc: Dense point cloud generation, mesh construction, and geometric correction using survey-grade photogrammetry pipelines.
surveying.p3Desc: Orthomosaics, DTMs, DEMs, .LAS point clouds, and Potree web viewer output — in your preferred coordinate system.
surveying.demoDesc: A fully navigable 3D point cloud generated from drone photogrammetry data over a real survey site — the kind of deliverable your team would receive.
surveying.demoNote: Outputs delivered as .LAS / .E57 point clouds, Potree web viewer, or integrated GIS layers.
surveying.ctaSub: Contact us for a free consultation on your surveying or construction monitoring project.
